spans.s: ष्टिध् r. 5th cl. (स्तिध्नुते) To assail, to assault, to attack.

ष्टिप्(ऋ)ष्टिपृ r. 1st cl. (स्तेपते)
 1. To ooze, to drop, to distil.
 2. To sprinkle.
ष्टिम् r. 4th cl. (स्तिम्यति) To be wet or moist, to reek, to steam.
ष्टीम् r. 4th cl. (स्तीम्यति) To be wet or moist, to reek, to steam.
